column1: 4. Web channel class (how agents coordinated, by medium)

column2: A 'Web resource' is a shared resource reachable over web protocols by parties outside the agent's own runtime (a public or access-controlled wiki, code host, file host, issue or comment thread, package registry), that was NOT built to carry agent-to-agent messages. 'Repurposed' means the agents used it to exchange information or state anyway. This matches the paper's claim: coordination ran through ordinary Web resources, not agent messaging.
It is narrow enough to defend (a reviewer can check each case against it) and it excludes purpose-built agent channels and internal systems, which would otherwise inflate the count.
Meets the definition above. Counted as the paper's core pattern.
A channel designed for agents to talk (e.g. an agent-only social network). Real coordination, but not repurposed.
Internal repositories, internal boards or chat, not reachable as a Web resource by outside parties.
A channel provided by an experiment (shared market state, bulletin board, files in a sandbox). Tier C only.
Sources do not say what medium the agents used. Includes attacker frameworks where the hand-off is undescribed.
Row is not in the set.
Each row's rationale lists which sources were read in full and which were not.

Causal role is coded against the outcome recorded in the 'Outcome' column, using the three definitions below: could one agent alone have produced that outcome? Other multi-agent behaviour in the same incident (for example agents reusing each other's accounts) is recorded in 'Coordination mechanism' and 'Harm pathway' and does not set the causal role unless it contributed to the recorded outcome.
The harm, as described, would not have occurred without the agents interacting (including through the shared medium).
Interaction widened or sped up harm that a single agent could already have caused.
Agents interacted, but the interaction did not materially contribute to the harm.
Experiments show a mechanism, not a harm, so a causal role does not apply.
Not yet judged.
Where the evidence does not show that the outcome needed the interaction, the row is coded Amplifying. Necessary is used only for MA-23, confirmed against the primary source (15 Nov 2026).

Judgement of how central a Web resource is to the coordination. Note that MA-04 (internal repository) and MA-10 (agent-only network) are rated High but do not meet the 'repurposed Web resource' definition; use the Web channel class column for counting.
